name: Uom includes the system units of measure
note:
The cube filtered `u.ad_client_id > 0`, excluding the 37 SYSTEM units at ad_client_id = 0 - exactly the rows the IN (tenant, 0) rule exists to include. Tenant 1000026 saw its own 7 instead of 44.

This is the same regression the 2022 model made by dropping the 0 from its tenant filter, still alive in this cube long after that was fixed elsewhere. Tenant scoping now comes from queryRewrite via the Client join, not from a predicate in the SQL.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM c_uom WHERE isactive='Y' AND ad_client_id IN (1000026,0)
